name: Cyclic Four-Coordinate Learning Space
definition: On coordinates $(r,a,b,s)$, take $\{\varnothing,r,ra,rab,s,rs,ras,bs,rbs,abs,rabs\}$. In low-bit order this is $\{0,1,3,7,8,9,11,12,13,14,15\}$.
properties: It is an eleven-concept learning space. Its four minimal missing patterns are $(a;\{r,b\})$, $(a;\{r,s\})$, $(b;\{a,s\})$, and $(b;\{r,s\})$. In logarithmic row-ratio coordinates its full coefficient space is the proper open halfspace $\log\alpha+\log\beta<0$ in $\mathbb R^8$, hence is homeomorphic to $\mathbb R^8$.
